body.objective: Students will be able to explore francophone music and shows.
body.iCan: I can explore francophone music and shows.
successCriteria: I can name types of francophone media and artists
I can give and justify opinions about media
I can compare two songs or shows using comparatives
body.hook: Québécois rap, Belgian comics, French films, Senegalese music, Acadian folk: the francophone world makes media for 320 million French speakers. Exploring it is one of the best ways to hear real French and share your opinion about it.

vocabulary.definition: I find that / I think that.

vocabulary.term: plus ... que / moins ... que / aussi ... que
vocabulary.definition: More ... than / less ... than / as ... as.

study.title: J'aime, je n'aime pas
study.question: How do I share and compare opinions about francophone media?
study.passage:
Francophone artists and media (teachers choose clips): Coeur de pirate (Québec, pop), Les Cowboys Fringants (Québec, folk-rock), Stromae (Belgium, electro-pop), Angèle (Belgium, pop), Youssou N'Dour (Senegal, mbalax, sings in Wolof and French), Radio-Canada and TV5Monde shows, French comics like "Astérix" and Belgian "Tintin."
Opinion phrases: J'aime / j'adore / je déteste... parce que... ; Je trouve que la chanson est entraînante (catchy) / ennuyeuse (boring) / émouvante (moving) ; À mon avis... ; Ce qui me plaît, c'est... (What I like is...).
Comparatives: Stromae est plus original que... ; Cette chanson est moins rapide que... ; Ce film est aussi drôle que... Irregular: bon → meilleur (better).
Dialogue:
Noah : Tu connais Angèle ?
Chloé : Oui ! J'adore sa chanson « Balance ton quoi ». Je trouve que les paroles sont importantes.
Noah : Moi, je préfère Stromae. À mon avis, sa musique est plus originale et ses vidéos sont meilleures.
Chloé : C'est vrai, mais Angèle est aussi talentueuse que Stromae !
Task: Listen to two songs. Rate each and write three opinion sentences and two comparisons.
study.source: Original activity and dialogue written for this lesson; teachers choose and preview media.
steps: Learn about francophone artists and media
Listen to and rate two songs
Write and share opinions and comparisons
discussion: Why is "meilleur" used instead of "plus bon"?
How do opinion phrases make your French sound more natural?
How does francophone media show the diversity of the French-speaking world?
study.product: Present a 90-second review in French comparing two francophone songs or shows, using at least three opinion phrases and three comparatives.

examples.answer: Je trouve que la chanson est entraînante.
examples.explore: Add a reason with parce que.

examples.title: Comparative
examples.problem: Say "Stromae is more original than Angèle."

examples.title: Equality
examples.problem: Say "This show is as funny as that film."
examples.answer: Cette émission est aussi drôle que ce film.

practice.a: I find that / I think that.
Angèle, Stromae, Coeur de pirate or another valid answer.

practice.q: What is the comparative of bon?
Translate: This song is less fast than the other.
practice.a: Cette chanson est moins rapide que l'autre.

practice.q: What does Chloé like about Angèle's song?

practice.a: His music is more original and his videos are better.

practice.q: Why is it "meilleures" in "ses vidéos sont meilleures"?
practice.a: It agrees with the feminine plural noun vidéos.

practice.q: Write an opinion with a reason about a show.
Name a francophone artist from Africa.
practice.a: Youssou N'Dour (Senegal) or another valid answer.

practice.q: Why is francophone media useful for learning French?
practice.a: It gives authentic language and culture from many regions.

misconceptions: Thinking French media comes only from France
exitTicket: Write one opinion sentence with a reason.
Write one comparison using plus, moins or aussi.
